admin.en: Pretest your survey with simulated participants.
admin.zh: 使用模拟参与者预试问卷。

admin.en: No runs yet. Choose personas and questions to start a pretest.
admin.zh: 暂无运行记录。选择人设与题目后即可开始预试。

admin.en: Open the AI Assistant sidebar — models and MCP stay in Settings
admin.zh: 打开 AI 助手侧栏 — 模型与 MCP 仍在设置中管理
通过对话设计当前项目

admin.en: Select a project first to send messages.
admin.zh: 请先选择一个项目再发送消息。

admin.en: Select a project to start chatting.
admin.zh: 请先选择项目再开始对话。

admin.en: Not connected — open Settings to add an API key.
admin.zh: 未连接 — 打开设置添加 API 密钥。

admin.en: Select a configured model before sending. The previous provider may have been removed.
admin.zh: 发送前请选择已配置的模型。之前的提供商可能已被移除。

admin.en: Ask the Assistant to design this survey
admin.zh: 让助手帮你设计这份问卷

admin.en: AI Assistant is ready. Describe the survey or a change you want.
admin.zh: AI 助手已就绪。描述你想要的问卷或修改即可。

admin.en: Open Settings to connect an API key, or use Codex / MCP from Integrations.
admin.zh: 打开设置连接 API 密钥，或通过集成使用 Codex / MCP。

admin.en: Type a message… (e.g. 'Create a thermal comfort survey')
admin.zh: 输入消息…（例如「创建一份热舒适问卷」）

admin.en: Select a project and configure a model first.
admin.zh: 请先选择项目并配置模型。
撤销上一次 AI 修改
预估：{calls} 次模型调用，{minTokens}–{maxTokens} tokens

admin.en: Optional: what should the reviewers focus on? Press Send to start the review.
admin.zh: 可选：希望评审重点关注什么？直接点发送即可开始评审。

admin.en: Draft changed during the review; not applied
admin.zh: 评审期间草稿已变更，未应用

admin.en: Show Review mode in the Assistant composer
admin.zh: 在助手输入框中显示「评审」模式

admin.en: These are your defaults. The Review options in the composer can still change them for a single run.
admin.zh: 这些是你的默认设置。助手输入框中的评审选项仍可在单次运行时修改。

admin.en: Could not save to your account. Your choice applies in this browser only.
admin.zh: 未能保存到账号，仅在当前浏览器生效。

admin.en: Add an instruction to the running Agent…
admin.zh: 给正在运行的智能体补充指令…
正在压缩上下文并继续…
正在核对刚保存的草稿…

admin.en: Advanced path for Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT via MCP.
admin.zh: 面向 Cursor、Claude 和 ChatGPT 的高级 MCP 路径。

admin.en: Connect an OpenAI or OpenRouter API key for this browser.
admin.zh: 为当前浏览器连接 OpenAI 或 OpenRouter API 密钥。

admin.en: Optional details that help the Assistant stay aligned with this project.
admin.zh: 这些信息是可选的，用于让助手在当前项目中保持方向一致。

admin.en: Keep conversation context and learned preferences within this project.
admin.zh: 仅在当前项目内保留对话背景和偏好。

admin.en: Conversation continuity is handled automatically by the hosted Agent session for this project.
admin.zh: 当前项目的对话连续性由托管 Agent 会话自动处理。

admin.en: Experimental and maintenance controls. Most studies do not need these.
admin.zh: 实验性与维护功能。大多数研究无需调整。

admin.en: Review mode runs a panel of reviewer roles on the current survey, in rounds, and proposes revisions. Set your defaults here.
admin.zh: 「评审」模式让多个评审角色分轮评审当前问卷并提出修订。可在此设置默认值。

admin.en: Review generated surveys with multiple specialist prompts
admin.zh: 使用多个专家提示审查生成的问卷

admin.en: Download this conversation or clear it from the current project.
admin.zh: 下载当前对话，或从当前项目中清空它。

admin.en: Clear conversation history for this project?
admin.zh: 清空此项目的对话历史？

admin.en: Create a new project or select an existing one from the sidebar to get started.
admin.zh: 请在侧栏新建项目，或选择已有项目开始。

admin.en: Save failed — click Save to retry
admin.zh: 保存失败 — 点击保存重试

admin.en: Start a survey and track your progress.
admin.zh: 开始创建问卷，查看项目进度。

admin.en: Shows the project checklist and top-bar tour again.
admin.zh: 重新显示项目清单和顶栏导览。

admin.en: The fastest path is to start from a published template and adapt it.
admin.zh: 最快的方式：从已发布的模板开始，再按需修改。

admin.en: Ticks itself from this project. Preview and sharing are remembered on this browser.
admin.zh: 根据本项目自动勾选。预览和分享记录保存在当前浏览器。

admin.en: All set: the survey is live and responses are coming in.
admin.zh: 全部就绪：问卷已上线，答卷正在进来。

admin.en: Holds the images, video and audio your questions show. Text-only surveys can skip it.
admin.zh: 存放题目要展示的图片、视频和音频。纯文字问卷可跳过。

admin.en: Upload files or folders, import a Hugging Face dataset, or import a template’s media. Tag folders as set or category so questions can draw from them.
admin.zh: 上传文件或文件夹、导入 Hugging Face 数据集，或从模板导入媒体。为文件夹标记 set 或 category，题目即可按文件夹抽取。

admin.en: No media yet. Upload files, import from Hugging Face, or import a template’s media.
admin.zh: 还没有媒体。可上传文件、从 Hugging Face 导入，或从模板导入。

admin.en: Defines what participants see: pages, questions, media rules and trial order.
admin.zh: 决定参与者看到什么：页面、题目、媒体规则和试次顺序。

admin.en: Add questions (rating, choice, pairwise comparison, ranking, annotation, video and more) or Skills. Preview each question while you edit; changes auto-save to the draft.
admin.zh: 添加题目（评分、选择、成对比较、排序、标注、视频等）或 Skill。编辑时可逐题预览，修改会自动保存到草稿。

admin.en: No questions yet. Add one in Builder or ask the AI Assistant to draft the survey.
admin.zh: 还没有题目。可在「设计」中添加，或让 AI 助手起草问卷。

admin.en: Catches unclear wording, broken media and wrong randomisation before real participants see them.
admin.zh: 在真实参与者之前发现表述不清、媒体失效或随机化错误。

admin.en: Preview in the top bar opens an exact replica of the live survey. Practice lets you answer question by question and inspect the recorded data.
admin.zh: 顶栏「预览」打开与线上问卷一致的副本；「试填」可逐题作答并查看记录下来的数据。

admin.en: Not tried yet. Take the full preview once before releasing.
admin.zh: 尚未试填。发布前请完整预览一遍。

admin.en: AI-simulated respondents give a quick pretest and hypothesis sketch. They never mix into human results.
admin.zh: AI 模拟受访者，用于快速预试和假设探索，绝不会混入真人结果。

admin.en: Choose a model and sample size, start a run, then review the answers. Runs continue in the background.
admin.zh: 选择模型和样本量，开始运行，再查看作答。运行会在后台继续。

admin.en: Silicon samples are turned off. Turn them on in Assistant settings to use this step.
admin.zh: 硅基样本已关闭。可在 AI 助手设置中开启后使用此步骤。

admin.en: Turns your draft into the participant version. The platform hosts the survey link, so there is nothing to deploy.
admin.zh: 把草稿变成参与者版本。问卷链接由平台托管，无需另行部署。

admin.en: Fix anything the pre-launch check flags, release a version (later releases update the same link), then copy the link or download the QR code.
admin.zh: 先处理发布前检查提示的问题，再发布版本（之后的发布沿用同一链接），然后复制链接或下载二维码。

admin.en: Not released yet. Releasing makes the current draft the participant version.
admin.zh: 尚未发布。发布后，当前草稿即成为参与者版本。

admin.en: Turns responses into per-question summaries you can export and report.
admin.zh: 把答卷整理成可导出、可汇报的逐题结果。

admin.en: Filter responses, read per-question charts, see TrueSkill rankings for comparisons with one tab per category, export CSV/JSON, or ask the AI Assistant to explain a result.
admin.zh: 筛选答卷、查看逐题图表；成对比较题按类别分标签显示 TrueSkill 排名；可导出 CSV/JSON，或让 AI 助手解释结果。

admin.en: No responses yet. Share the link, then come back here.
admin.zh: 还没有答卷。先分享链接，再回到这里。

admin.en: AI Assistant: help on every step
admin.zh: AI 助手：每一步都能帮忙

admin.en: Click AI in the top bar to chat about the current project. Choose a mode in the message box:
admin.zh: 点击顶栏「AI」，就当前项目对话。在输入框选择模式：

admin.en: Plans and carries out multi-step work: reads the draft, edits it, imports media, and asks before risky actions.
admin.zh: 规划并完成多步任务：读取草稿、修改、导入媒体，执行高风险操作前会先征求同意。

admin.en: Drafts a complete survey from your description in one go.
admin.zh: 根据你的描述一次性起草完整问卷。

admin.en: Makes only the change you ask for and keeps everything else as it is.
admin.zh: 只做你要求的修改，其余内容保持不变。

admin.en: Read-only. Answers questions about the survey or its results without changing anything.
admin.zh: 只读。回答关于问卷或结果的问题，不做任何修改。

admin.en: Multiple reviewer roles rate and comment on the survey in rounds, then propose revisions you can apply.
admin.zh: 多个评审角色分轮为问卷打分和点评，并提出可应用的修订。

admin.en: The Assistant uses your own API key (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenAI and others), saved in AI & Integrations.
admin.zh: AI 助手使用你自己的 API 密钥（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、OpenAI 等），保存在「AI 与集成」中。

admin.en: The AI Assistant is turned off. Turn it on in Assistant settings.
admin.zh: AI 助手已关闭，可在 AI 助手设置中开启。

admin.en: Advanced: Codex, Cursor or Claude Code via MCP
admin.zh: 进阶：通过 MCP 使用 Codex、Cursor 或 Claude Code

admin.en: Connect an external agent in AI & Integrations. It edits the same draft with the same safety checks. Example prompt:
admin.zh: 在「AI 与集成」中连接外部智能体，它会以相同的安全检查编辑同一份草稿。示例提示词：

admin.en:
Using sp_survey MCP, create a survey about <your topic>.
Add question types <question types>.
My media is <description> at <folder location>.
admin.zh:
使用 sp_survey MCP，创建一份关于 <你的主题> 的问卷。
加入题型 <题型说明>。
我的媒体是 <描述>，位于 <文件夹位置>。

admin.en: Open your projects, create a new one, or start from a published template.
admin.zh: 打开你的项目、新建项目，或从已发布的模板开始。

admin.en: Work left to right: Dataset, Builder, Share, Results. Practice and Silicon help you test.
admin.zh: 从左到右：媒体、设计、分享、结果。「试填」和「硅基」用于测试。

admin.en: Edits save to your draft automatically. The participant link changes only when you release.
admin.zh: 修改会自动保存到草稿。只有发布后，参与者链接的内容才会变化。

admin.en: Answer the whole survey exactly as participants will.
admin.zh: 以参与者视角完整作答整份问卷。

admin.en: Ask the Assistant to build or change the survey from any tab.
admin.zh: 在任意标签页让助手构建或修改问卷。

admin.en: Opens the participant link in a new tab.
admin.zh: 在新标签页打开参与者链接。

admin.en: Theme, Skills library, and your account.
This Introduction tab keeps the checklist, and Restart guide brings everything back.
admin.zh: 「简介」标签页保留清单，「重新开始引导」可恢复全部提示。
导入模板 / 预览媒体

admin.en: Copy media from a published template or the admin preview media library. Existing files are skipped so imports can resume.
admin.zh: 从已发布模板或管理端预览媒体库复制文件。已存在文件会跳过，便于断点续传。

admin.en: Upload into the current folder in Media library
admin.zh: 上传到媒体库中的当前文件夹

admin.en: Each file: max {mb} MB. Image compression is optional; video, audio and animated GIFs retain their original data.
admin.zh: 单文件上限 {mb} MB。图片可选择压缩；视频、音频和动态 GIF 保留原文件。

admin.en: "{name}" is too large ({size} MB). Video/audio max is {mb} MB.
admin.zh: 「{name}」过大（{size} MB）。视频/音频上限 {mb} MB。

admin.en: No folders tagged yet. In Media library, check folders on the left and click Set or Category. Tagged folders will appear here for survey assignment.
admin.zh: 尚未标记文件夹。在媒体库左侧勾选文件夹，再点击“分组”或“分类”。标记后的文件夹会显示在这里，供问卷分配使用。

admin.en: Folders tagged set. Each folder’s direct files stay together when a question uses “Random fixed sets” with a matching media count.
admin.zh: 标记为分组的文件夹。题目使用“随机固定分组”且媒体数量匹配时，文件夹内直属文件会一起展示。

admin.en: Folders tagged category. Questions can draw random files from each category.
admin.zh: 标记为分类的文件夹。题目可从每个分类中随机抽取文件。
正在检查 R2 中的现有图片…

admin.en: Batch-import from HuggingFace. Use owner/dataset (rows) or owner/dataset/folder (recursive; nested folders kept). Resume reuses the first import destination to avoid nested duplicates.
admin.zh: 从 HuggingFace 批量导入。使用 owner/dataset（按行）或 owner/dataset/folder（递归；保留嵌套文件夹）。继续导入会复用首次目标路径，避免重复嵌套。

admin.en: Tag folders as set. Each tagged folder’s direct files are shown together (set size must match the question’s media count).
admin.zh: 将文件夹标记为分组（Set）。每个分组文件夹的直属文件会一起展示，每组文件数须与题目的媒体数量一致。

admin.en:
1. Create folders block01, block02, block03
2. Put 2 images in each folder (same count)
3. Check those folders → click Set
4. In Survey Builder, choose media mode Random fixed sets with count = 2
→ each respondent sees one whole folder (both images together)
admin.zh:
1. 创建文件夹 block01、block02、block03
2. 每个文件夹放 2 张图（数量相同）
3. 勾选这些文件夹 → 点击“分组”
4. 在问卷构建中选择媒体分配方式「随机抽取完整分组」，数量 = 2
→ 每位受访者看到一整文件夹（两张图一起）

admin.en: Tag folders as category. In Survey Builder, choose Per category and set Files per category. Each tagged folder contributes that many random file(s) (drawn recursively).
admin.zh: 将文件夹标记为分类（Category）。在题目中选择「按分类抽取」，并设置每个分类抽取的文件数。每个分类会从该文件夹及其子文件夹中随机抽取。

admin.en:
1. Create folders street and park
2. Put several images in each (subfolders OK)
3. Check those folders → click Category
4. In the question: Media Assignment → Per category, Files per category = 2
→ each respondent sees 2 street + 2 park images (4 total)
admin.zh:
1. 创建文件夹 street 与 park
2. 每个放若干图片（可用子文件夹）
3. 勾选这些文件夹 → 点击“分类”
4. 在题目中：媒体分配 → 按分类抽取，每类文件数 = 2
→ 每位受访者看到 2 张 street + 2 张 park（共 4 张）

admin.en: Design questions and configure your survey.
The main title that appears at the top of your survey
admin.zh: 显示在问卷顶部的主标题

admin.en: A brief description explaining the purpose of your survey
Shown to participants after they submit the survey
admin.zh: 参与者提交后显示的内容

admin.en: Close the survey automatically after this many responses (leave empty for unlimited)
admin.zh: 达到该答卷数后自动关闭问卷（留空表示不限）

admin.en: Organize your survey into pages. Drag pages to reorder them.
admin.zh: 将问卷组织为多个页面。可拖拽页面调整顺序。

admin.en: Publish your survey and invite participants.
admin.zh: 发布问卷，邀请参与者作答。

admin.en: Scan to open this survey. Download a 1024 × 1024 PNG for sharing or printing.
admin.zh: 扫码打开此问卷。可下载 1024 × 1024 PNG，用于分享或打印。

admin.en: Could not generate the QR code.
Local preview only. Use the deployed site to share with participants.
admin.zh: 当前为本地预览，请在线上平台分享问卷。

admin.en: No project selected. Please select or create a project first.
admin.zh: 未选择项目。请先选择或创建项目。

admin.en: Send it via email, WeChat, Slack, or any other channel
admin.zh: 可通过邮件、微信、Slack 等渠道发送

admin.en: Download the QR code from Your Survey Link above for invitations, slides or printed materials
admin.zh: 在上方“你的问卷链接”中下载二维码，可用于邀请、幻灯片或印刷材料
同一个研究使用同一个链接

admin.en: With version management enabled, publish a release to update this link. Saving only updates your draft.
admin.zh: 启用版本管理后，发布正式版本才会更新链接；保存只更新草稿。

admin.en: Results go to Supabase in real time and can be viewed in the Results Analysis tab
admin.zh: 结果实时写入 Supabase，可在结果分析标签页查看

admin.en: Share this link with collaborators who need to edit the survey. They will need to sign in.
admin.zh: 分享给需要编辑问卷的协作者；对方需登录。
当前分析和导出包含 {shown} / {total} 份提交。

admin.en: CSV contains one row per submission. ZIP includes per-trial tables and summaries.
admin.zh: CSV 每行一份提交；ZIP 包含逐轮长表和汇总。

admin.en: Filters are saved in this browser; they do not modify the survey.
admin.zh: 筛选偏好仅保存在当前浏览器，不会修改问卷。

admin.en: No submissions match these filters. Reset filters to see all responses.
admin.zh: 没有符合当前筛选条件的提交。重置筛选可查看全部答卷。

admin.en: One answer evaluates the entire displayed media group. Each ordered group is counted once.
admin.zh: 一次回答评价整组展示媒体，每种有序媒体组合只计一次。
已回答 {answered} / {total} 份提交（{rate}%）· {people} 位参与者

admin.en: These responses span multiple questionnaire revisions. Analysis and export use the selected version only to avoid mixing incompatible settings. Switch versions below; historical responses without a revision remain unknown.
admin.zh: 这些答卷涉及多个问卷版本。分析和导出仅使用当前所选版本，避免新旧设置混算。可在下方切换；未记录版本的历史答卷仍标为未知。

admin.en: Analyze survey responses per question for project:
This analysis did not produce a complete report. Run the analysis again.
admin.zh: 此次分析未生成完整报告，请重新运行分析。

admin.en: Delete this saved analysis report? Survey responses will be kept.
admin.zh: 删除这份已保存的分析报告？调查答卷将保留。

admin.en: Could not save the analysis report. Please try again.
admin.zh: 分析报告保存失败，请重试。

admin.en: Could not delete the report. Please try again.
No analysis report yet. Analyze current results to generate one.
admin.zh: 还没有分析报告。点击“分析当前结果”生成。

admin.en: This report used a previous range. Analyze again to update.
admin.zh: 这份报告来自之前的分析范围。请重新分析以更新。

admin.en: New responses arrived after this report. Analyze again to update.
admin.zh: 报告之后又有新答卷。请重新分析以更新。
标注 × 感知 深入分析

admin.en: Dates use {tz}. Records without a valid timestamp are excluded when a date filter is active.
admin.zh: 日期按 {tz} 计算。启用日期筛选时，没有有效时间戳的记录不纳入。

admin.en: Quality flags are checks, not deletions.
admin.zh: 质量标记只是检查信息，不会自动删除答卷。

admin.en: Some historical responses have no frozen question contract. Current settings are a fallback.
admin.zh: 部分历史答卷没有冻结题目合同，当前分析使用现有设置作为替代。

admin.en: Formal analysis uses human responses unless you choose practice or a Silicon run.
admin.zh: 正式分析默认使用真人数据；练习或 Silicon 需明确选择。
分析时排除已标记答卷
至少有 1 条作答的可答题

admin.en: Remove individual submissions from this project. Deletion is permanent.
admin.zh: 删除本项目的单条提交。删除后不可恢复。

admin.en: View answers, trial details and quality flags for each submission.
admin.zh: 查看每份提交的答案、逐轮详情及质量标记。

admin.en: No responses collected yet. Share your survey link and come back here to view results.
admin.zh: 尚无答卷。分享问卷链接后，再回到这里查看结果。

admin.en: Custom skill results reuse native charts by declared type: annotation overlays (points/path/polygon/bbox), media ranking (number/boolean with imageUrl), or text/ranking/allocation charts.
admin.zh: 自定义 Skill 结果按声明类型复用原生分析：标注类（points/path/polygon/bbox）叠加热力/图形；媒体评分类按图片排序；文字/排序/分配类用对应原生图表。

admin.en: This skill stores multiple tasks in one question, distinguished by mode (e.g. cue ranking / route trace).
admin.zh: 此 Skill 把多种任务写在同一个题里，用 mode 区分（例如线索排序 / 路线描绘）。

admin.en: One readable summary per person; expand raw JSON when needed.
admin.zh: 每人一条可读摘要；需要时可展开原始 JSON。

admin.en: Answer fields only — shown media is listed separately per response.
admin.zh: 仅显示答案字段；刺激媒体在每条下方单独列出。

admin.en: No answer was recorded for this question (submit button did not save, or it was skipped).
admin.zh: 此题尚未记录到答案（完成键未成功写入，或未作答）。
正式调查前试答并检查题目。

admin.zh: 申请已提交。请保存你的待审核模板 ID。

admin.zh: 状态：待审核（尚未进入公共库）。通过后，打开研究者面板并使用此模板 ID。

admin.zh: 请填写姓名、邮箱、研究标题与研究说明。

admin.zh: 请输入有效邮箱，以便我们跟进。

admin.zh: 请更详细描述你的研究（至少几句话）。

admin.zh: 你想测量什么、对象是谁、大致如何进行？几句话即可。

admin.en: What participants will see or hear.
admin.zh: 参与者将看到或听到的内容。

admin.zh: 论文、项目页或数据集 URL

admin.zh: 设想的题型、样本量、约束条件等。

admin.zh: 图片、视频或音频示例。图片上传前会自动压缩。

admin.zh: 方案说明、PDF、幻灯片、表格、ZIP 等 — 每个最大 {mb} MB。

phrases.en: Why: streetlevel depends on pyexiv2, whose bundled libexiv2 on macOS is linked against Homebrew’s gettext and inih. Without them the helper stops at start with “Library not loaded: …libINIReader…”. Not needed on Windows or Linux. No Homebrew? Get it at brew.sh.
phrases.zh: 原因：streetlevel 依赖 pyexiv2，它在 macOS 上自带的 libexiv2 链接了 Homebrew 的 gettext 和 inih；缺少时本地工具一启动就会报 “Library not loaded: …libINIReader…”。Windows 和 Linux 不需要这一步。没有 Homebrew？请到 brew.sh 安装。

phrases.en: Four road directions (front / right / back / left)
phrases.zh: 沿道路四个方向（前 / 右 / 后 / 左）
Google 街景（无需 key，默认）

phrases.en: All map, road, area and grid points share these settings; points from pasted Street View URLs keep their own heading, pitch and FOV.
phrases.zh: 地图、沿路、区域和网格点位共用这些设置；来自粘贴街景网址的点位保留各自的 heading、pitch 和 FOV。

phrases.en: Google Street View via streetlevel uses unofficial Google endpoints and conflicts with Google’s terms. Runs on your computer; see Download settings.
phrases.zh: 通过 streetlevel 下载 Google 街景使用的是 Google 非官方接口，与 Google 条款冲突。在你的电脑上运行；详见“下载设置”。

phrases.en: Mapillary images are CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution is saved with every file.
phrases.zh: Mapillary 影像采用 CC BY-SA 4.0 许可，每个文件都会保存署名。

phrases.en: Mapillary uses its official Graph API with your own free access token. Images are CC BY-SA 4.0: the contributor and a link are saved with each file and in features/street_level_v1.csv; keep that attribution when you publish them.
phrases.zh: Mapillary 使用官方 Graph API 和你自己的免费 access token。影像采用 CC BY-SA 4.0：每个文件及 features/street_level_v1.csv 中都保存了贡献者和链接，发布时请保留署名。

phrases.en: Mapillary needs a free access token. Paste it in Download settings, or switch back to Google Street View, which needs no key.
phrases.zh: Mapillary 需要免费 access token。请在“下载设置”中填写，或改回无需 key 的 Google 街景。

phrases.en: Mapillary needs a free client token; Google Street View does not. Stored only in this browser and sent only to your local helper. Get one at
phrases.zh: Mapillary 需要免费的 client token，Google 街景不需要。只保存在本浏览器中，只发送给你的本地工具。获取地址：

phrases.en: For the command line, set the token first: MAPILLARY_TOKEN=… (macOS / Linux) or set MAPILLARY_TOKEN=… (Windows).
phrases.zh: 命令行方式请先设置 token：MAPILLARY_TOKEN=…（macOS / Linux）或 set MAPILLARY_TOKEN=…（Windows）。

phrases.en: If pip says “externally-managed-environment” (Homebrew or Debian/Ubuntu Python), use a private environment instead:
phrases.zh: 如果 pip 提示 “externally-managed-environment”（Homebrew 或 Debian/Ubuntu 自带的 Python），请改用独立环境：

phrases.en: No python3? Install Python from python.org/downloads, or run brew install python if you use Homebrew.
phrases.zh: 没有 python3？请从 python.org/downloads 安装 Python；使用 Homebrew 的话也可以运行 brew install python。

phrases.en: No py command? Install Python from python.org/downloads (the installer adds the py launcher).
phrases.zh: 没有 py 命令？请从 python.org/downloads 安装 Python（安装程序会附带 py 启动器）。

phrases.en: No python3? Install it with your package manager (e.g. sudo apt install python3 python3-venv) or from python.org/downloads.
phrases.zh: 没有 python3？用系统包管理器安装（例如 sudo apt install python3 python3-venv），或从 python.org/downloads 获取。

phrases.en: Choose a view in the Google Maps window, copy the address bar URL and paste it here; that point keeps its own heading, pitch and FOV.
phrases.zh: 在 Google Maps 窗口中选好视角，复制地址栏网址粘贴到这里；该点位会保留自己的 heading、pitch 和 FOV。

phrases.en: Paste one Google Street View URL. It replaces this point’s heading, pitch, FOV and panorama id.
phrases.zh: 粘贴一条 Google 街景网址。它会替换该点位的 heading、pitch、FOV 和全景 id。

phrases.en: Paste one Street View URL, not several.
phrases.zh: 请只粘贴一条街景网址，不要一次粘贴多条。

phrases.en: That URL is not a Street View panorama.
phrases.zh: 这条网址不是街景全景。
不是 Google Maps 网址

phrases.en: Street View panoramas are 360°: views are re-projected from the panorama on your computer; “Full panorama” saves the stitched equirectangular image.
phrases.zh: 街景全景为 360°：视角图在你的电脑上由全景重投影生成；“完整全景”保存拼接后的等距柱状图。

phrases.en: Downloads use the open-source streetlevel library, which reads Google Street View through the unofficial endpoints of Google’s own viewer. This is not an official Google API, and it goes against Google’s terms, which forbid downloading and storing Street View images, including for research. It runs on your computer and under your responsibility; the platform only receives the finished files.
phrases.zh: 下载使用开源的 streetlevel 库，它通过 Google 自家查看器的非官方接口读取 Google 街景。这不是 Google 官方 API，并且违反 Google 条款（条款禁止下载和保存街景图像，研究用途也不例外）。下载在你的电脑上进行，由你自行承担责任；平台只接收最终生成的图片文件。
已中断（本地工具已重启），请点“继续”
标记为 category 的文件夹
每个点位一个 set 文件夹

phrases.en: 0. macOS only — install two Homebrew libraries first:
phrases.zh: 0. 仅限 macOS —— 先安装两个 Homebrew 库：
浏览器拦截了本地工具

phrases.en: The helper is running, but this browser blocked it.
phrases.zh: 本地工具已在运行，但浏览器拦截了连接。

phrases.en: Start the local helper first (commands in Download settings).
phrases.zh: 请先启动本地工具（命令见“下载设置”）。

phrases.en: {done} done ({files} file(s)), {none} without coverage, {failed} failed, {pending} pending — of {total}.
phrases.zh: 共 {total} 个：完成 {done}（{files} 个文件），无覆盖 {none}，失败 {failed}，待处理 {pending}。

phrases.en: {n} file(s) in the media library folder “{f}”.
phrases.zh: 媒体库文件夹“{f}”中已有 {n} 个文件。

Without the browser (same batch, one command):
phrases.zh: 不用浏览器（同一批次，一条命令）：

phrases.en: This point keeps its own view instead of the batch settings.
phrases.zh: 该点位使用自己的视角，而不是批量设置。

phrases.en: Leave empty to use the batch settings.
Pick points on our own map or paste Google Street View URLs, then a small helper on your computer downloads the views (no API key) into this media library with location metadata.
phrases.zh: 在平台自带地图上选点或粘贴 Google 街景网址，再由你电脑上的小工具下载对应视角（无需 API key），连同位置元数据存入本项目媒体库。

phrases.en: The local helper is not running on this computer.
phrases.zh: 本机未检测到正在运行的本地工具。

phrases.en: Then start it and keep the terminal open:
phrases.zh: 然后启动它，并保持终端窗口打开：

phrases.en: This panel detects it automatically. It listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
phrases.zh: 面板会自动检测到它；它只监听 127.0.0.1。

phrases.en: The local helper rejected the job: {e}
Sign-in expired; sending a fresh session to the helper…
phrases.zh: 登录已过期，正在向本地工具发送新的会话…

phrases.en: {done} done ({files} file(s)), {none} without Street View coverage, {failed} failed, {pending} pending — of {total}.
phrases.zh: 共 {total} 个：完成 {done}（{files} 个文件），无街景覆盖 {none}，失败 {failed}，待处理 {pending}。

phrases.en: {n} of these files are in the media library folder “{f}”.
phrases.zh: 其中 {n} 个文件已在媒体库文件夹“{f}”中。
备用方式：一条命令，无需浏览器

phrases.en: Downloads this project’s saved point list with the options above; signs in through your browser the first time.
phrases.zh: 按上面的选项下载本项目已保存的点位列表；首次运行会通过浏览器登录。

phrases.en: Click along a road, then Finish to sample every {s} m.
phrases.zh: 沿道路依次点击，然后点“完成”，每 {s} 米采样一个点。

phrases.en: Click the corners of an area, then Finish to fill it with a {s} m grid.
phrases.zh: 依次点击区域各顶点，然后点“完成”，以 {s} 米网格填充。

phrases.en: Click the map to add a point.
Click two opposite corners, then Finish to create a {s} m grid.
phrases.zh: 点击矩形的两个对角，然后点“完成”，生成 {s} 米网格。
确定删除全部 {n} 个点位？

phrases.en: Drag to pan. Click a point to select it.
phrases.zh: 拖动平移地图，点击点位可选中。

phrases.en: Google Maps is used only to choose points. Browse Street View in the Google window, copy the address bar URL, and paste it here. No Google API key is used and no Google imagery is stored.
phrases.zh: Google Maps 仅用于选点：在 Google 窗口中浏览街景，复制地址栏网址后粘贴到这里。不使用 Google API key，也不保存任何 Google 影像。
{label}：新增 {added} 个，跳过重复 {dup} 个{over}。

phrases.en: No points yet. Click the map, draw a road / area / grid, paste Google URLs, or import a file.
phrases.zh: 暂无点位。可点击地图、绘制道路 / 区域 / 网格、粘贴 Google 网址或导入文件。
，{n} 个超出 {max} 个点位上限
在 Google 街景中打开

phrases.en: Paste Google Maps / Street View URLs (one or many)
phrases.zh: 粘贴 Google Maps / 街景网址（可一次粘贴多个）

phrases.en: Short links could not be resolved: {e}
Please play the media to the end before answering.
phrases.zh: 请完整观看/收听媒体后再作答。

phrases.en: Media failed to load. Retry before continuing.
phrases.zh: 媒体加载失败，请重试后再继续。

phrases.en: Use built-in tasks directly in Survey Builder; no import is needed. This page stores your custom interactions for private reuse or optional public review.
phrases.zh: 常用题型和内置交互可在问卷编辑器直接选择，无需导入。本页保存你定制的交互，可私有复用，也可选择申请公开。

phrases.en: Create an editable copy of a built-in task (optional)
phrases.zh: 从内置交互创建可编辑副本（可选）

phrases.en: No custom interactions yet. Built-in question types are ready to use in Survey Builder.
phrases.zh: 还没有自定义交互。常规问卷直接使用内置题型即可。

phrases.en: Dimension setup is incomplete: add a display name and both pole labels.
phrases.zh: 维度配置不完整：请补全显示名称和两端说明。

phrases.en: Not enough matching media for all trials. Check folders, sets, categories and reuse settings.
phrases.zh: 当前抽图规则没有足够的匹配媒体完成所有轮次，请检查文件夹、分组、分类或去重设置。

phrases.en: Preview could not load. Edit the question or reopen the preview.
phrases.zh: 预览加载失败，请修改题目或重新打开预览。

phrases.en: Clear answers and restart at the first trial. Random media is resampled; manual selections stay fixed.
phrases.zh: 清空试答并回到第一轮；随机题重新抽图，手动指定的图片保持不变。

phrases.en: Rendered at device width, then scaled to fit. Scroll and try answers inside; editing resets preview answers. Results are not saved.
phrases.zh: 按设备实际宽度排版，缩放仅用于适应此面板；可在预览内滚动和试答。修改设置会重置试答，不保存结果。

phrases.en: Choose a standard output, then customize the interaction. Built-in tasks are available directly in Survey Builder. Each custom interaction handles one task; the platform provides analysis and export.
phrases.zh: 先选标准输出，再定制交互。内置题型可在问卷编辑器直接使用；这里用于特殊交互。每个交互完成一项任务，平台统一分析与导出。

phrases.en: Custom interactions currently save one result per question. Use separate questions when each round needs its own record.
phrases.zh: 自定义交互目前每题保存一次结果。需要多轮记录时请拆题，不要在 HTML 内覆盖前几轮答案。
起步模板（切换会重置尚未保存的代码）

phrases.en: After changing settings, test again. Match the interaction’s controls to these settings in the advanced editor or with Codex.
phrases.zh: 修改设置后请重新试答；代码中的量程和选项也应相符，可在高级编辑或交给 Codex 修改。

phrases.en: This interaction does not require media.
This action leaves the editor or replaces the starter. Keep editing to retain unsaved content.
phrases.zh: 此操作会离开编辑器或替换当前模板。继续编辑可保留未保存的内容。

phrases.en: Media failed to load. Please retry.
Loading media. The timer has not started…
phrases.zh: 正在加载媒体，尚未开始计时…

phrases.en: Viewing time is over — please answer based on your impression.
phrases.zh: 展示结束，请根据刚才的印象作答。

phrases.en: Some historical responses have no recorded question definitions. Their original settings cannot be fully restored; analysis may use current settings as a reference. Verify against raw JSON.
phrases.zh: 部分历史答卷没有保存题目定义，无法还原当时的全部设置。当前分析可能使用现有题目作为参考，请结合原始 JSON 复核。

phrases.en: This attempt is kept unchanged on this page. Retry submission to confirm it without creating a duplicate.
phrases.zh: 本次答案已在当前页面保留。请重试提交以确认保存，不会重复新增记录。

phrases.en: Click a count to inspect images. Annotation and review cover the library; scores use the selected question; analyzable and missing features use current filters.
phrases.zh: 点击数量查看具体图片。标注与审核统计全库；评分对应所选题目；可分析与缺特征遵循当前筛选。

phrases.en: These historical scores cannot be matched to current media. Check their source records; filenames are never merged automatically.
phrases.zh: 这些历史评分无法确定对应的当前媒体。请核对来源记录；系统不会按文件名自动合并。

phrases.en: Open the source to inspect it, or go to its annotation when available. Missing scores require responses to the selected question.
phrases.zh: 可打开原始媒体核对；有权限时可直接进入该图片的标注。缺评分需通过对应题目收集回答。

phrases.en: Search filename, folder or media ID
phrases.zh: 搜索文件名、文件夹或媒体 ID

phrases.en: Submissions are not enabled yet. Please try again later.
phrases.zh: 投稿功能尚未启用，请稍后再试。

phrases.en: The content or review status changed. Reopen the submission or load the latest document and merge your changes.
phrases.zh: 内容或审核状态已改变。请重新打开申请，或载入最新文档后合并修改。

phrases.en: The document could not be found.
Submitted. Publication requires administrator review. Track status and feedback below.
phrases.zh: 已提交。管理员审核后才会发布；你可以在下方查看状态和反馈。

phrases.en: Latest source loaded. Your proposal is preserved; compare it with the source below and merge before resubmitting.
phrases.zh: 已载入最新原文。你的提案仍在编辑框中；请与下方原文比较、手动合并后重新提交。

phrases.en: Help build SP-Wiki: edit documentation, share template tutorials or introduce your research. Any signed-in user can submit; administrators review before publication.
phrases.zh: 一起建设 SP-Wiki：修改文档、分享模板教程或介绍研究成果。任何登录用户都可以投稿，管理员审核后公开发布。

phrases.en: Sign in to submit and track your contributions.
phrases.zh: 请登录后提交和查看自己的申请。

phrases.en: Start a new contribution and clear the editor?
phrases.zh: 开始新投稿会清空当前编辑框，是否继续？

phrases.en: Change language and clear the editor?
phrases.zh: 切换语言会清空当前编辑框，是否继续？

phrases.en: Change document and clear the editor?
phrases.zh: 切换文档会清空当前编辑框，是否继续？

phrases.en: Displayed publicly with an approved article.
phrases.zh: 审核通过后随文章公开展示。

phrases.en: Headings, tables, links and image URLs are supported. The platform provides template previews, live settings and scoring tools. Keep access keys and participant personal data out of the text.
phrases.zh: 支持标题、表格、链接和图片链接。模板预览、实时设置和计分组件由平台提供。不要粘贴访问密钥或参与者个人信息。
修改说明 / 投稿说明（仅审核可见）
来源与素材授权说明（仅审核可见）

phrases.en: Include reader-facing references and DOIs in the article too. Use public image URLs you have permission to share.
phrases.zh: 正文中也应保留读者需要的引用和 DOI。图片请使用可公开访问、获授权的链接。

phrases.en: I have permission to contribute this text and media and agree to publication under the name above after review.
phrases.zh: 我确认有权提交这些文字和素材，并同意审核通过后以所填署名公开发布。
载入最新原文以合并修改

phrases.en: Open this submission and replace the editor?
phrases.zh: 打开此申请会替换当前编辑框，是否继续？
标注与图像特征 × 感知

phrases.en: Choose a perception question, check feature–score matching, then analyze and export.
phrases.zh: 选择感知题目，检查标注与评分的对应关系，再分析和导出。

phrases.en: Feature loading failed. Analysis and export paused:
phrases.zh: 特征加载失败，已暂停分析与导出：

phrases.en: Exploratory analysis uses current annotations and features, not a feature snapshot frozen with the questionnaire. Coverage removes overlaps; box area is not segmented object area. Group-level ratings are excluded from per-image analysis.
phrases.zh: 探索性分析：使用当前标注和图像特征，不会随问卷版本自动冻结。标注覆盖率去除重叠；矩形框面积不等于物体分割面积。成组评分不能归给单张图片，因此不纳入单图分析。

phrases.en: Some legacy features have no source annotations and cannot be rebuilt or assigned verified zeros. Review before formal analysis.
phrases.zh: 部分旧特征缺少原始标注，无法重算覆盖率或确认零值；请核对后再用于正式分析。

phrases.en: Some historical scores do not match current media. Original identities are retained; same-name images are not guessed.
phrases.zh: 部分历史评分无法对应当前媒体。已保留原始身份，不会按同名图片强行匹配。

phrases.en: Stars use BH-FDR adjusted p-values across all tested features. Small samples and repeated ratings require caution; not causal.
phrases.zh: 星号使用全部特征的 BH-FDR 校正 p 值；小样本及重复评分需谨慎解释，不表示因果。

phrases.en: Tested on participant-level agreement with the pooled ranking (pairwise) or participant mean ratings (ratings). Exploratory.
phrases.zh: 检验对象：每位参与者与总体排名一致的比例（两两比较），或参与者平均评分（评分题）。仅供探索。

phrases.en: Reverse-coded wording: the chosen image counts as the loser.
phrases.zh: 本题为反向措辞：被选中的图计为输家。

phrases.en: Min–max scaling is relative to this sample and not comparable across studies.
phrases.zh: 最小–最大缩放只相对于当前样本，不能跨研究比较。

phrases.en: Export long format (one row per choice)
phrases.zh: 导出长表（每次选择一行）

phrases.en: participant(s) always chose the same side (≥5 trials)
phrases.zh: 位参与者始终选同一侧（≥5 次）

phrases.en: below the minimum number of ratings
Needs at least 2 raters who rated the same 2+ stimuli.
phrases.zh: 需要至少 2 位评分者共同评过至少 2 个刺激物。

phrases.en: Add a second annotation question (e.g. "disliked") to build an evaluative map.
phrases.zh: 需要另一道标注题（如"不喜欢"）才能生成综合评价地图。

phrases.en: No media available to pick from.
No category folders tagged yet (or none match this filter). Tag folders as category in Media Dataset.
phrases.zh: 尚未标记分类文件夹，或没有符合筛选条件的分类。请在媒体库中将文件夹标记为“分类”。

phrases.en: Prefer unused media; if the filtered pool is too small, fall back to the unfiltered range
phrases.zh: 优先不重复已展示的媒体；范围内不足时会回退到该范围未过滤池

phrases.en: Shown only for two options in single-select mode. Ties are counted separately; TrueSkill uses decisive answers only.
phrases.zh: 仅在展示两个选项且为单选时显示。平局单独统计，现有 TrueSkill 排名仅使用明确胜负。

phrases.en: Leave blank to follow the survey language.
phrases.zh: 留空时跟随问卷语言自动显示。
参与者预览（修改设置后自动更新）

phrases.en: The Assistant stays on the same layer so unsaved settings remain.
phrases.zh: 助手与题目设置同层，不会挡住未保存内容。

phrases.en: Your question settings have not been saved. Keep editing to retain them.
phrases.zh: 题目设置尚未保存。继续编辑可保留当前内容。

phrases.en: Media uploaded, but saving the media list failed. Retry saving.
phrases.zh: 媒体已上传，但媒体清单保存失败，请重试保存。

phrases.en: Folder uploads keep the selected folder name and subfolders inside the current directory. Only media files are imported; empty folders are omitted.
phrases.zh: 文件夹上传会保留所选文件夹名称和子文件夹层级，放入当前目录。仅导入媒体文件；空文件夹不会导入。

phrases.en: Compress large images for faster loading (keep original GIFs)
phrases.zh: 压缩大图以加快加载（GIF 保留原文件）

phrases.en: Uncheck when original pixels matter. Original files: up to 40 MB. Same-name files are stored separately.
phrases.zh: 研究需要原始像素时取消勾选；原文件最大 40 MB。同名文件会分别保存。

phrases.en: Use the up/down buttons or drag the handle (touch: press and hold), or confirm the current order.
phrases.zh: 点击上下箭头或拖动手柄调整顺序（手机上长按拖动），也可以确认当前顺序。

phrases.en: A data-format example, not a real answer. Multi-trial questions save each answer with its shown media. Run the full assignment check on Share Survey.
phrases.zh: 这是数据格式示例，不是真实答案。多轮题会逐轮保存答案及当时展示的媒体。完整分配检查在“分享问卷”页运行。

phrases.en: Complete the media/task settings and verify the answer in participant preview.
phrases.zh: 请先补齐媒体或任务设置，再通过参与者预览验证答案。

phrases.en: Separate keywords with commas, semicolons or newlines. Case-insensitive; spaces stay within phrases.
phrases.zh: 多个关键词用逗号、分号或换行分隔，不区分大小写；空格保留为词组。
整个媒体库（含所有子文件夹）

phrases.en: Matches image filenames, not visual content. Uses the criteria in this dialog and keeps your existing selection.
phrases.zh: 仅匹配图片文件名，不识别画面内容；使用这里的查找条件，保留已有勾选。

phrases.en: Enter keywords to see matching images.
phrases.zh: 输入关键词后查看匹配图片。

phrases.en: Previewing the first 12; confirmation selects all matches.
phrases.zh: 仅预览前 12 张，确认后选中全部匹配图片。

phrases.en: Analysis and export below use only this test answer. No response is saved; one test answer cannot establish statistical reliability.
phrases.zh: 以下仅使用本次试答展示正式分析与导出，不会保存答卷。单条试答不能说明统计可靠性。

phrases.en: Each participant is randomly assigned to one condition, keeping the groups balanced. With two or more conditions, each question can use different wording per condition (in question settings).
phrases.zh: 每位参与者会被随机分到其中一个条件，各条件人数自动保持平衡。添加至少两个条件后，可以在题目设置里为每个条件写不同的题干。

phrases.en: Add at least two conditions to enable assignment.
phrases.zh: 至少需要两个条件才会分组。

phrases.en: e.g. site or pid, comma-separated. When a participant link contains ?site=S01 the value is recorded (exported as url_site). The Share tab builds one link and QR code per value.
phrases.zh: 例如 site 或 pid，用逗号分隔。参与者链接里带上 ?site=S01 时会记录这个值（导出为 url_site 列）。在「分享」页可以为每个取值生成专属链接和二维码。

phrases.en: This survey has experimental conditions: everyone opens the same link above and is randomly assigned. No separate links are needed.
phrases.zh: 本问卷设置了实验条件：每位参与者打开上面的同一个链接时会被随机分到一个条件，不需要为不同条件准备不同的链接。

phrases.en: Links with parameters (one per site or channel)
phrases.zh: 带参数的链接（每个地点 / 渠道一个链接）

phrases.en: Recovered unsaved annotations. Retry saving to sync them.
phrases.zh: 有尚未保存的标注，已恢复。请点击重试保存。

phrases.en: Question numbers match the list below. Every selected condition must match.
phrases.zh: 题号与下方题目列表一致。多个条件要同时满足。

phrases.en: Configuration errors or missing media prevent release. Fix the Share Survey check first. Released studies cannot depend on the preview media library.
phrases.zh: 配置错误或媒体不足，不能发布。请先修复分享页试运行报告中的问题；正式版本不能依赖临时预览媒体库。

phrases.en: Question order, pages or survey settings may also differ.
phrases.zh: 题目顺序、分页或问卷设置也可能发生变化。

phrases.en: If a column or function is missing, apply research_releases.sql first. For other errors, refresh and retry.
phrases.zh: 若提示列或函数不存在，请先应用 research_releases.sql；其他错误请刷新重试。

phrases.en: Not enabled: saves still update the share link. Your first release separates drafts from the participant version.
phrases.zh: 尚未启用：保存仍立即影响分享链接。首次发布后启用草稿与正式版本分离。

phrases.en: Save your current changes, then refresh versions.
phrases.zh: 请先保存当前修改，再刷新版本。

phrases.en: Fix draft configuration errors in Survey Builder before releasing.
phrases.zh: 草稿存在配置错误，请先在题目设置中修复。

phrases.en: No earlier version loaded; compared with an empty baseline
phrases.zh: 当前列表无上一版本，按空白基线显示

phrases.en: Legacy snapshot has no media manifest; it can be inspected but not fully restored.
phrases.zh: 历史快照未记录媒体清单，仅可查看，不能完整恢复。

phrases.en: New participants will receive this version. Started responses keep their existing questions and media; history is retained.
phrases.zh: 这会更新新参与者看到的问卷。已经开始的答卷继续使用原有题目与媒体；历史记录会保留。

phrases.en: Restoring also replaces the current draft and media organization.
phrases.zh: 恢复还会替换当前草稿和媒体分类。
发出问卷前，先试跑一次

phrases.en: Check media assignment, trials and example-answer exports. Test data stays in this browser and is never submitted.
phrases.zh: 检查媒体分配、轮数及示例答案的分析导出。只在浏览器生成测试数据，不保存为正式答卷。

phrases.en: This does not fetch media, execute custom HTML, or predict real answers or completion time. Also test the participant preview.
phrases.zh: 此检查不验证媒体能否实际打开、不执行自定义 HTML、不预测真实回答或完成时间。正式分享前仍需体验参与者预览。

phrases.en: Download test report with simulated answers
phrases.zh: 下载测试报告（含模拟答卷）

phrases.en: A/B refer to the first/second stimulus in each recorded media list. Ties are valid answers counted separately; TrueSkill uses decisive outcomes only and excludes ties.
phrases.zh: A/B 对应每条记录中展示媒体的第一/第二项。平局是有效回答，单独统计；TrueSkill 排名仅使用明确胜负，不包含平局。

phrases.en: Saved changes update the live survey.
phrases.zh: 保存后即更新参与者问卷。

phrases.en: This survey has no answerable questions. Add questions before inviting participants.
phrases.zh: 问卷还没有作答题，请先在题目设置中完善。

phrases.en: There are unsaved changes. Wait for the toolbar to show saved before sending the share link.
phrases.zh: 当前有未保存的修改。请确认顶部显示已保存，再发送分享链接。

phrases.en: ⚠️ The draft changed after this review, so the revision was not applied. Run the review again.
phrases.zh: ⚠️ 评审后草稿已被修改，未应用修订。请重新运行评审。
媒体加载失败，点击重试
唯一前提是 Python 3.9 或更新版本（macOS 另需下面列出的两个 Homebrew 库）。适用于 macOS、Windows 和 Linux；不需要 pipx、git，也不需要修改 PATH。
phrases.gloss: The only prerequisite is Python 3.9 or newer (on macOS, plus two Homebrew libraries shown below). Works on macOS, Windows and Linux; no pipx, git or PATH changes needed.

phrases.zh: macOS 使用 ~/.sp-streetlevel 私有环境，因此不会升级 Anaconda 或 conda base 里的包。请用下面的命令重新安装，然后重启 serve 并批准证书提示。在 Safari 中打开 https://sp-survey.org 时，面板通过 https://127.0.0.1:47822 连接。
phrases.gloss: macOS uses a private environment at ~/.sp-streetlevel, so this does not upgrade packages inside Anaconda or conda base. Reinstall with the command below, then restart serve and approve the certificate prompt. Safari on https://sp-survey.org uses https://127.0.0.1:47822.

phrases.zh: 这样不会改动 Anaconda 或 conda base。在那里使用 pip install --user 可能升级 cryptography，导致 conda 自带的 pyopenssl 无法使用。
phrases.gloss: This leaves Anaconda and conda base alone. Installing with pip --user there can upgrade cryptography and break conda’s pyopenssl.

phrases.zh: 如果这台电脑上 python3 -m sp_streetlevel serve 已经能用，继续用它：
phrases.gloss: If python3 -m sp_streetlevel serve already works on this computer, keep using it:

phrases.zh: 面板先请求 https://127.0.0.1:47822/health，再请求 http://127.0.0.1:47821/health。
phrases.gloss: The panel calls https://127.0.0.1:47822/health first, then http://127.0.0.1:47821/health.

phrases.zh: 本地工具已在运行，但浏览器拦截了连接。请使用下面的备用命令。
phrases.gloss: The helper is running, but this browser blocked the connection. Use the backup command below.

phrases.zh: 原因：streetlevel 依赖 pyexiv2，它在 macOS 上自带的 libexiv2 链接了 Homebrew 的 gettext 和 inih；缺少时本地工具一启动就会报 “Library not loaded: …libINIReader…”。Windows 和 Linux 不需要这一步。没有 Homebrew？请到 brew.sh 安装。
phrases.gloss: Why: streetlevel depends on pyexiv2, whose bundled libexiv2 on macOS is linked against Homebrew’s gettext and inih. Without them the helper stops at start with “Library not loaded: …libINIReader…”. Not needed on Windows or Linux. No Homebrew? Get it at brew.sh.

phrases.zh: 沿道路四个方向（前 / 右 / 后 / 左）
phrases.gloss: Four road directions (front / right / back / left)

phrases.zh: Google 街景（无需 key，默认）
地图、沿路、区域和网格点位共用这些设置；来自粘贴街景网址的点位保留各自的 heading、pitch 和 FOV。
phrases.gloss: All map, road, area and grid points share these settings; points from pasted Street View URLs keep their own heading, pitch and FOV.

phrases.zh: 通过 streetlevel 下载 Google 街景使用的是 Google 非官方接口，与 Google 条款冲突。在你的电脑上运行；详见“下载设置”。
phrases.gloss: Google Street View via streetlevel uses unofficial Google endpoints and conflicts with Google’s terms. Runs on your computer; see Download settings.

phrases.zh: Mapillary 影像采用 CC BY-SA 4.0 许可，每个文件都会保存署名。
phrases.gloss: Mapillary images are CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution is saved with every file.

phrases.zh: Mapillary 使用官方 Graph API 和你自己的免费 access token。影像采用 CC BY-SA 4.0：每个文件及 features/street_level_v1.csv 中都保存了贡献者和链接，发布时请保留署名。
phrases.gloss: Mapillary uses its official Graph API with your own free access token. Images are CC BY-SA 4.0: the contributor and a link are saved with each file and in features/street_level_v1.csv; keep that attribution when you publish them.

phrases.zh: Mapillary 需要免费 access token。请在“下载设置”中填写，或改回无需 key 的 Google 街景。
phrases.gloss: Mapillary needs a free access token. Paste it in Download settings, or switch back to Google Street View, which needs no key.

phrases.zh: Mapillary 需要免费的 client token，Google 街景不需要。只保存在本浏览器中，只发送给你的本地工具。获取地址：
phrases.gloss: Mapillary needs a free client token; Google Street View does not. Stored only in this browser and sent only to your local helper. Get one at

phrases.zh: 命令行方式请先设置 token：MAPILLARY_TOKEN=…（macOS / Linux）或 set MAPILLARY_TOKEN=…（Windows）。
phrases.gloss: For the command line, set the token first: MAPILLARY_TOKEN=… (macOS / Linux) or set MAPILLARY_TOKEN=… (Windows).

phrases.zh: 如果 pip 提示 “externally-managed-environment”（Homebrew 或 Debian/Ubuntu 自带的 Python），请改用独立环境：
phrases.gloss: If pip says “externally-managed-environment” (Homebrew or Debian/Ubuntu Python), use a private environment instead:

phrases.zh: 没有 python3？请从 python.org/downloads 安装 Python；使用 Homebrew 的话也可以运行 brew install python。
phrases.gloss: No python3? Install Python from python.org/downloads, or run brew install python if you use Homebrew.

phrases.zh: 没有 py 命令？请从 python.org/downloads 安装 Python（安装程序会附带 py 启动器）。
phrases.gloss: No py command? Install Python from python.org/downloads (the installer adds the py launcher).

phrases.zh: 没有 python3？用系统包管理器安装（例如 sudo apt install python3 python3-venv），或从 python.org/downloads 获取。
phrases.gloss: No python3? Install it with your package manager (e.g. sudo apt install python3 python3-venv) or from python.org/downloads.

phrases.zh: 在 Google Maps 窗口中选好视角，复制地址栏网址粘贴到这里；该点位会保留自己的 heading、pitch 和 FOV。
phrases.gloss: Choose a view in the Google Maps window, copy the address bar URL and paste it here; that point keeps its own heading, pitch and FOV.

phrases.zh: 粘贴一条 Google 街景网址。它会替换该点位的 heading、pitch、FOV 和全景 id。
phrases.gloss: Paste one Google Street View URL. It replaces this point’s heading, pitch, FOV and panorama id.

phrases.zh: 不是 Google Maps 网址
街景全景为 360°：视角图在你的电脑上由全景重投影生成；“完整全景”保存拼接后的等距柱状图。
phrases.gloss: Street View panoramas are 360°: views are re-projected from the panorama on your computer; “Full panorama” saves the stitched equirectangular image.

phrases.zh: 下载使用开源的 streetlevel 库，它通过 Google 自家查看器的非官方接口读取 Google 街景。这不是 Google 官方 API，并且违反 Google 条款（条款禁止下载和保存街景图像，研究用途也不例外）。下载在你的电脑上进行，由你自行承担责任；平台只接收最终生成的图片文件。
phrases.gloss: Downloads use the open-source streetlevel library, which reads Google Street View through the unofficial endpoints of Google’s own viewer. This is not an official Google API, and it goes against Google’s terms, which forbid downloading and storing Street View images, including for research. It runs on your computer and under your responsibility; the platform only receives the finished files.
